instruction: Take off all the wuantities f the manhole and pipe system

given_data.Manhole Component 1: GI Cover and frame Dimensions 600mm x 450mm
given_data.Manhole Component 2: 100mm thick pcc slab reinforced with mesh reinforcement A193
given_data.Manhole Component 7: Thickness between invert depth and base concrete 50mm
given_data.Note 3: All upvc pipes to be laid directly on the ground
given_data.Note 4: Manholes over 1000mm deep to be provided with step irons
given_data.Note 5: Pccc pipe to be laid on 150 mmm deep and 600 mm wide concrete bed
given_data.Note 6: Depth from top of manhole to ground level should be 50mm

phases.phase_name: Calculate Manholes Invert Levels and Manholes External dimensions

steps.heading: Manhole 1 External Dimensions
steps.thought: Need total width and length of the manhole including the walls and projection for the pit excavations and manhole materials
steps.formula: External Dimensions = Internal Dimensions + 2(Wall Thickness)
steps.result: MH1 External Dimensions = 1200mm x 900mm

steps.heading: Calculate manhole Total Depth
steps.thought: Need to calculate the depth of the manhole to use in excavation and manhole materials
steps.formula: Dy = x / 40 , D2 = D1 + Dy ,Depth = D2 + Manhole Component 6 + Manhole Component 7 + Note 6
steps.result: MH1 Total Depth = 850mm below GL

steps.heading: Manhole 2 External Dimensions
steps.thought: Need to calculate the external dimensions of the manhole to use in excavation and manhole materials
steps.formula: External Dimensions = Internal Dimensions + 2(Wall Thickness)
steps.result: MH2 External Dimensions = 1500mm Diameter

steps.heading: Calculate manhole Total Depth
steps.thought: Need to calculate the depth of the manhole to use in excavation and manhole materials
steps.formula: Dy = x / 40 , D2 = D1 + Dy, x = Length - (Mh2 External Length / 2) - (Manhole 1 External Length / 2) ,Depth = D2 + Manhole Component 6 + Manhole Component 7 + Note 6
steps.result: MH1 Total Depth = 1041.25mm below GL

steps.heading: Manhole 3 External Dimensions
steps.thought: Need to calculate the external dimensions of the manhole to use in excavation and manhole materials
steps.formula: External Dimensions = Internal Dimensions + 2(Wall Thickness)
steps.result: MH3 External Dimensions = 1500mm x 1200mm

steps.heading: Calculate manhole Total Depth
steps.thought: Need to calculate the depth of the manhole to use in excavation and manhole materials
steps.formula: Dy = x / 40 , D2 = D1 + Dy, x = Length - (Mh2 External Length / 2) - (Manhole 1 External Length / 2) ,Depth = D2 + Manhole Component 6 + Manhole Component 7 + Note 6
steps.result: MH2 Total Depth = 1878.75mm below GL, 1st Stage = 1500mm , Second Stage = 1878.75 - 1500 = 378.75mm

phases.phase_name: Final Excavation Dimensions and Descriptions for Takeoff sheet

steps.heading: Manhole Excavation Pits
steps.thought: Need to give Final Dimensions and Descriptions for the excavation  of pits to recieve manholes depth Not exceeding 1500mm
steps.result: [{"MH1": "1200 x 900 x 850mm", "MH2": "(3.1415/4 x 1500 x 1500) x 1041.25mm", "MH3": "1500 x 1200 x 1500mm"} "Description : Excavate pits to recieve Manholes Not Exceeding 1500mm epth commencing from Ground Level and Cut away spoil" ]

steps.heading: Manhole Excavation Pits
steps.thought: Need to give Final Dimensions and Descriptions for the excavation  of pits to recieve manholes depth exceeding 1500mm
steps.result: [{"MH3": "1500 x 1200 x 378.75"} "Description : Excavate as above described above 1500mm deep but not exceeding 3000mm deep commencing from 1500mm below ground level and cut away spoil" ]

steps.heading: Take off for plunking,strutting and dewatering
steps.thought: Need to give  final  dimensins and descriptions for plunking,strutting and dewatering
steps.result: [{"ITEM": "} "Description : Allow for necessary plunking and strutting and allow for Dewatering" ]

steps.heading: Take off for plain concrete Bed
steps.thought: Need to give  final  dimensins and descriptions for the takeoff of Plain concrete bed

steps.heading: Manhole 1 Mean Girth calculation
steps.thought: Need to calculate mean girth of wall inorder to know dimensions of wall takeoff
steps.formula: mean_girt = 2(length + width) - Number of corners / width of wall
steps.result: Manhole 1 wall mean girth = 2600mm

steps.heading: Manhole 2 Mean Girth calculation
steps.thought: Snce Manhole is circular we Need to calculate circumference of wall inorder to know dimensions of wall takeoff
steps.formula: Circumference = 2 x Pi x Diameter / 2
steps.result: Manhole 2 wall mean girth = 4712mm

steps.heading: Manhole 3 Mean Girth calculation
steps.thought: Need to calculate mean girth of wall inorder to know dimensions of wall takeoff
steps.formula: mean_girt = 2(length + width) - Number of corners / width of wall
steps.result: Manhole 1 wall mean girth = 3600mm

steps.heading: Manhole 1 wall height
steps.thought: Need to calculate height of wall for taking off dimensions
steps.formula: Height = Invert_Depth - 100(pcc slab thickness) + 50(Thickness between invert depth and base concrete)
steps.result: Manhole 1 wall height = 550mm

steps.heading: Manhole 2 wall height
steps.thought: Need to calculate height of wall for taking off dimensions
steps.formula: Height = Invert_Depth - 100(pcc slab Thickness) + 50(Thickness between invert depth and base concrete)
steps.result: Manhole 1 wall height = 741.25mm

steps.heading: Manhole 3 wall height
steps.thought: Need to calculate height of wall for taking off dimensions
steps.formula: Height = Invert_Depth - 100(pcc slab Thickness) + 50(Thickness between invert depth and base concrete)
steps.result: Manhole 1 wall height = 1628.75mm

steps.heading: Wall take off
steps.thought: Need to show final wall dimensions and descriptions for the dimension paper
steps.result: [{"MH1": "3.60 x 0.55", "MH2": "(3.1415/4 x  0.74 x 1.50)", "MH3": "4.80 x 1.628"} "Description : 150mm thick stone wall including bedding and jointing in cement sand mortar" ]

steps.heading: Take off for Manhole Benching
steps.thought: Need to give  final  dimensins and descriptions for the takeoff of benching
steps.result:
[{1"} "Plain Concrete (1 : 3 : 6 ) in 175 mm avarage hgh benching to manhole internal size 900 x 600 including finishing smoth to fall  "

 & 
 Ditto but to manhole 3 Internal size 1200 x 900 mmm including finishing  smooth to fall ]

steps.heading: Internal perimeter of manhole 1 wall
steps.thought: I need to provide the calculation of the Internal Perimeter and Depth of Manhole 1
steps.formula: perimeter =  2(Length  width),  Depth = Internal Height of Wall - Rendering Height
steps.result: Internal Perimeter  and Height of wall  3000mm , 375mm

steps.heading: Internal circumference of manhole 2 wall
steps.thought: I need to provide the calculation of the ircumference and Depth of Manhole 2
steps.formula: circumference = pi x Diameter,  Depth = Internal Height of Wall - Rendering Height
steps.result: Internal Circumference  and Height of wall 3.142 x 1500 , 566.25mm

steps.heading: Internal perimeter of manhole 1 wall
steps.thought: I need to provide the calculation of the Internal Perimeter and Depth of Manhole 1
steps.formula: perimeter =  2(Length  width),  Depth = Internal Height of Wall - Rendering Height
steps.result: Internal Perimeter  and Height of wall  4200mm , 1453.75mm

steps.heading: Final Dimension and Descriptions for rendering takeoff
steps.thought: I need to provide the Final Dimesnions and dscriptions as to be provided in Dimension paper
steps.result: [{"MH1": "4.20 x 1.45"}{"MH2": "3.142 x 1.5 x 0.57"}{"MH3": "3.0 x 0.38"} "Description : 12mmm thick c/s moisture proof render to stone wall" ]

steps.heading: Stepped Irons Take off
steps.thought: I need to create a query sheet inorder to assume the  spacing of stepped irons since the information is not provided then use that to calculate number of stepped irrons
steps.formula: Number of steps =  depth of manhole / spacing
steps.working: Quarry sheet : [{Question : what is spacing of stepped iron},{Answer : assume 300mm}], Number of steps = 1453.75/ 300 = 4.8
steps.result: Number of stepped irons  = 5

steps.heading: Final Dimension and Descriptions for Stepped irons
steps.thought: I need to provide the Final Dimesnions and dscriptions for stepped irons take off as is to be provided in Dimension paper
steps.result: [{4 x 1"} "Description : Mild steel steeped iron fish tailed both ends twice bent at right angles and set in cement mortar" ]

steps.heading: Take off for manhole Cover slab
steps.thought: Need to give  final  dimensins and descriptions for the takeoff of cover slab as is to be filled in Dimension Paper
steps.result:
[{1"} "Description : Precast concrete cover slab size 1200 x 900 x 100 mmm thick reinforced with mesh reinforcement A193 opening size 600 x 450 mm 
 & 
 Ditto but  1500mm Diameter x 100 mmm thick 
 & 
 Ditto  but 1500 x 1200 x 100 mm ]

steps.heading: Take off for manhole Cover frame
steps.thought: Need to give  final  dimensions and descriptions for the takeoff of cover frame as is to be filled in Dimension Paper
steps.result: [{3 x 1"} "Description : 600 x 450 mm Gulvanised iron cover and frame including setting frame in ( 1 : 3 ) mortar.]

steps.heading: Depth of GTI and Wc Query sheet
steps.thought: I need to create a querry sheet inorder to assume the depth of GTI and Wc since they are not provided
steps.working: [{Question : what is the depth at GTI and Wc},{Answer : say 300mm}]
steps.result: Depth at GTI and Wc is  300mm

steps.heading: Average Depth of Trench fro Wc to Mh1
steps.thought: I need to show calculation of the avarage depth of the pipe trench from wc and Mh1
steps.formula: Mh1 total depth - (150mm thick base concrete + Thickness between invert depth and base concrete 50mm) = Mh1 Depth, Mh1 Depth + Wc Depth = total depth , Average Depth = Total Depth / 2
steps.result: Average depth of pipe trench from wc to MH1 is 425mm

steps.heading: Average Depth of Trench from Mh1 to Mh2
steps.thought: I need to show calculation of the avarage depth of the pipe trench from Mh1 to Mh2
steps.formula: Manhole total depth - (150mm thick base concrete + Thickness between invert depth and base concrete 50mm) = Manhole Depth, Mh1 Depth + Mh2 Depth = total depth , Average Depth = Total Depth / 2
steps.result: Average depth of pipe trench from MH1 to Mh2 is 695.625mm

steps.heading: Average Depth of Trench fro Gt to Mh2
steps.thought: I need to show calculation of the avarage depth of the pipe trench from Gt and Mh1
steps.formula: Mh2 total depth - (150mm thick base concrete + Thickness between invert depth and base concrete 50mm) = Mh2 Depth, Mh2 Depth + Gt Depth = total depth , Average Depth = Total Depth / 2
steps.result: Average depth of pipe trench from wc to MH1 is 570.63mm

steps.heading: Average Depth of Trench from Mh2 to Mh3
steps.thought: I need to show calculation of the avarage depth of the pipe trench from Mh2 to Mh3
steps.formula: Manhole total depth - (150mm thick base concrete + Thickness between invert depth and base concrete 50mm) = Manhole Depth, Mh3 Depth + Mh2 Depth = total depth , Average Depth = Total Depth / 2
steps.result: Average depth of pipe trench from MH1 to Mh2 is 1219.75mm

steps.heading: Average Depth of Trench from Mh3 to Sewer
steps.thought: I need to show calculation of the avarage depth of the pipe trench from Mh3 to Sewer
steps.formula: x = distance from Mh3 to property boundary + road thickness , Dy = x / 40 ,D2 = depth at Mh3 + Dy , Total Depth = depth at Mh3 + D2, D2 = Depth at Sewer, Average Depth = 1/2 x Total Depth, Total average Depth = avarage Depth + thickness of concrete bed
steps.result: Average depth of pipe trench from MH3 to Sewer is 2128.25mm

steps.heading: Length of Trenches
steps.thought: I need to show the length of the trenches that will recieve the pipes
steps.result: wc - Mh1 : length = 1350mm , Mh1 - Mh2 : length = 8650mm , Gt - Mh2 : length = 3500 - 150/2 = 2750mm, Mh2 - Mh3 :  length = 25500mm , Mh3 - Sewer : 14000 + 10000 = 24000mm
